title: The river is turned
description: Adar's engines bring down a cliff upstream and dam the river that guards the city. The bed runs dry, and the Orcs storm the walls on foot.

title: Elrond pleads with Durin
description: Elrond begs Durin for an army, and Durin agrees — until his father, deep in the ring's grip, orders the diggers down toward the mithril and the thing that sleeps below it. Durin stays to stop him.

title: The Nine
description: Celebrimbor notices a mouse he has seen before, and the illusion of a peaceful city cracks. He finishes the Nine in chains while Annatar turns his own smiths against him. Mirdania is hurled from the wall.

title: The charge of Lindon
description: Gil-galad and Elrond arrive with the cavalry of Lindon. Adar stops their charge by holding up his hostage: Galadriel.

title: Arondir frees Galadriel
description: Following the Orcs' trail all the way from the south, Arondir slips into the camp by night and helps Galadriel escape into the besieged city.

title: Celebrimbor's last gift
description: Celebrimbor cuts off his own thumb to slip his chains and puts the Nine into Galadriel's hands. He stays behind to buy her time.

title: Dawn without the Dwarves
description: At sunrise the Dwarves have not come. A troll breaks the wall and the last Elves are overrun; Adar cuts Arondir down and takes Nenya from Elrond.
